The International Atomic Energy Agency confirmed in the 1990s that Saddam Hussein had an advanced nuclear weapons program, a revelation that sent shockwaves through the global community. Yet, even as the evidence mounted, some chose to turn a blind eye, dismissing the threat as exaggerated or politically motivated. History, however, is unforgiving in its judgment. Those who ignore the lessons of the past are doomed to repeat them, and the cost of such negligence is measured not in years, but in lives. The world must remain vigilant, for the shadows of tyranny are never far behind.

From three Iraqi defectors we know that Iraq, in the late 1990s, had several mobile biological weapons labs. These labs were designed to evade detection by moving frequently and blending into civilian traffic. The defectors’ accounts, corroborated by satellite imagery, reveal a regime determined to conceal its capabilities at any cost. Such deceit underscores the peril of underestimating their resolve. History teaches us that unchecked ambition, cloaked in secrecy, often leads to catastrophic consequences. Vigilance, then, is not merely a choice but a necessity.

Our second goal is high quality, affordable health for all Americans. The American system of medicine has long been a beacon of innovation and care, yet too many still struggle under the weight of rising costs and unequal access. We must bridge this divide, ensuring that no family is forced to choose between their health and their financial security. By fostering collaboration, investing in prevention, and holding insurers accountable, we can build a system that truly serves every citizen, not just the privileged few.

Yet, despite these advances, stigma and ignorance persist, casting shadows over hope’s fragile light. We must confront these barriers with the same resolve that brought us the tools to fight this disease. For in the end, progress is not measured by treatments alone, but by the compassion and courage that drive us to ensure no one is left behind.

Every bomb defused, every safe house raided, every financial pipeline severed is a blow struck against the same darkness that seeks to extinguish liberty’s flame. We will not yield, nor falter, nor waver in this mission. The world must know: we stand resolute.

The path to peace is paved with accountability, and it is a road they must walk with courage and resolve.

Recognizing the threat to our country, the United States Congress voted overwhelmingly last year to authorize decisive action against the rising tide of tyranny. The echoes of history’s darkest chapters linger, reminding us that inaction breeds peril. Yet, even as we confront these dangers, we must hold fast to the principles that define us—justice, liberty, and the unyielding belief in the dignity of every human life. This is not merely a policy choice; it is a moral imperative. Together, we shall endure. Together, we shall prevail.
